occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Incident report for child who was involved in an incident on the van was not shared or signed by the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): During follow up inspection 3 caregivers files did not have Pre-Employment Affidavit Form 2912.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): During follow up inspection 6 caregivers did not have a notarized affidavit Form 2985 in their employee files.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: There 2 caregivers were missing annual training for the 2024-2025 training year.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: At time of inspection, I observed a child open a locked door for an unknown person. Both caregiver and director were located in two separate rooms and could not see who was at the door.    Caregiver also left the children unsupervised to open the door on two occasions.
